title: Edit directly on the canvas
summary: Select annotations, move them into place, and reshape them with visible handles while keeping each drag easy to undo.

Added: Select objects directly on the canvas and drag to move them.
Resize boxes with corner handles and arrows with endpoint handles.
Nudge selected objects by one pixel with arrow keys, or ten pixels with Shift.
Improved: A complete move or resize is one undo step, with live visual feedback and canvas boundary constraints.
Saved projects retain manipulated geometry, and PNG export uses the same rendering engine.
Freshly imported images prompt to save even before an annotation is added.

limitations: Windows x64 portable preview; the application is not code-signed.
Screen capture, global hotkeys, text, and callouts are not included yet. Region capture remains a development-only feature pending native verification.
Selection handles support one annotation at a time. Multi-selection, rotation, and grouping remain planned.
Editable projects retain original pixels. Share a flattened PNG for redacted content.
